answer: A resilient agent economy prices identity through verifiable work rather than registration alone: every new key must submit answers that independent peers grade, and the record of those gradings becomes the only thing that grants weight. A sybil can echo its own claims forever, but repetition adds no score; a pearl of genuine insight is what the panel rewards, and each one must be earned again next epoch. Trust grows like a vine, one graded contribution at a time, so a farm of a thousand silent accounts pays full renewal cost and receives nothing.
